channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Record Fourth of July travel brings heavy traffic to Florida roads
item.description: AAA estimates 72.2 million Americans traveled at least 50 miles from home this Fourth of July weekend, marking an all-time high for the holiday.

item.title: S.D. Spady Elementary in Delray Beach jumps from C to A rating as Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive A
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County earned an A rating from the state for the third consecutive year, with 143 district-operated schools rated A or B and a record 93.5% graduation rate.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities nationwide to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, making it the only Florida city honored this year.

item.title: Juno Beach residents demand fence replacement at JB-7 beach access as trespassing disputes escalate
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos in Juno Beach say people using the JB-7 public beach walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed a fence in 2023, leading to confrontations and police calls.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook post
item.description: The Martin County School Board filed a court challenge Thursday against an administrative law judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher suspended last year .

item.title: Martin County maritime teams on standby as hundreds of boaters expected for Fourth of July weekend
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit will have two boats with medics on standby in the north and south parts of the county as hundreds of boaters celebrate the Fourth of July weekend on local waterways.

item.title: Hobe Sound community launches fundraiser for man who lost fiancee in deadly home fire
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Friends have launched a fundraiser to help her fiance Mark rebuild after the flames destroyed the couple's belongings.

item.title: Breast cancer patient denied reconstruction coverage by Anthem hours before surgery
item.description: Beth Clark, 48, was denied coverage for her breast reconstruction surgery by Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield less than 24 hours before the procedure, which involved a surgical mesh called GalaFlex.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4% as ground beef and strawberry prices rise
item.description: A Fourth of July cookout for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Port St. Lucie moves forward on Midway Road expansion and Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange at the Florida Turnpike on Midway Road.

item.title: West Palm Beach considers elevated autonomous transit connecting downtown to airport
item.description: California-based Glydways will present a proposal to Palm Beach County commissioners Tuesday for an elevated network of self-driving vehicles connecting downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.title: Fort Pierce Peacock House Art Foundation attracts global artists to historic Crain Estate
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, preserving the legacy of Jaxson and Mary Crain while connecting local and international artists through an artist-in-residency program.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman dies in home fire as community raises funds for fiance
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside her Hobe Sound home. Preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closing Monday for $3 million renovation to expand slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a year-long $3 million renovation that will nearly double its capacity from 18 to 44 slips for both motorize.

item.title: Martin County Maritime Response Unit stations two boats with medics for Fourth of July weekend
item.description: Martin County maritime teams are deploying two boats with medics in the north and south parts of the county as hundreds of boaters celebrate the Fourth of July weekend on the water.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Sunday for $3 million renovation adding 26 boat slips
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a year-long $3 million renovation that will expand capacity from 18 to 44 slips for motorized and non-motorized vessels.

item.title: Heavy traffic and rain hit South Florida roads as record Fourth of July travel continues
item.description: Record Fourth of July travel numbers are bringing heavy traffic to South Florida roads, with AAA estimating 72.2 million Americans will travel at least 50 miles from home during the holiday period.

item.title: Breast cancer patient and surgeon speak out after insurance denies reconstruction surgery hours before procedure
item.description: Beth Clark, a 48-year-old breast cancer patient, and her surgeon are speaking out after Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield denied coverage for reconstruction surgery less than 24 hours before it was scheduled.

item.description: The Saint Andrew's Scots football team is targeting a state title in the 2026 fall season after finishing last year with a 10-2 record and a district championship. item.title: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach offers sea turtle nesting season programs through September
item.description: Loggerhead Marinelife Center in Juno Beach is offering a variety of educational programs during peak sea turtle nesting season through September. Guests can participate in guided Turtle Walks, the Hatchling Discovery Program, Hatchling Releases, Tidal Tots and Plastic Free July Community Action Day.

item.title: North Palm Beach celebrates Independence Day with fireworks and pool party at country club
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Florida offers free state park admission for America's 250th Independence Day
item.description: The Florida Department of Environmental Protection is waiving admission fees at state parks from Friday through Sunday to celebrate the nation's semiquincentennial.

item.title: DeSantis signs $117.6 billion Florida budget with $810 million in vetoes
item.description: Gov. Ron DeSantis signed a $117.6 billion state budget this week, marking the fourth consecutive year of a shrinking spending plan. item.description: Cities from Sarasota to Fort Myers Beach are staging waterfront celebrations, drone shows and patriotic parades to mark the semiquincentennial.

item.title: Delray Beach opens 1976 Bicentennial Time Capsule for America's 250th celebration
item.description: The city will open a half-century old time capsule at its Fourth of July celebration, one of dozens of Florida events on the national America250 calendar.

item.title: Marion County stages four synchronized fireworks displays for semiquincentennial
item.description: Ocala and Marion County are hosting fireworks at four sites, parades and free aquatic center access as part of Marion Celebrates 250.

item.title: Voting rights activist warns of rollback attempts on America's 250th anniversary
item.description: Michael Waldman ties the semiquincentennial to the ongoing struggle to fulfill the Declaration of Independence's promise of expanded voting rights.
